rejected_automatic_decay.reason: Explicit e_decay behavior retained: automatic per-episode decay harmed quality and produced final failures.

limitations: Only three training seeds and finite test horizons; no convergence guarantee.
Early DQN policies violate evaluation bounds, although final policies do not.
GeoSat is a rounded dimensionless local linearization. Legacy input limits are uncalibrated numerical settings.
The policy benchmark uses a separate regulation wrapper and quadratic reward, not native GeoSatEnv reward.
SAC transfer uses ComSat policies from round 10 without retraining; arbitrary older GeoSat policies were not tested.
Ray optimizer tests excluded because the optional ray dependency is absent.
Legacy GeoSat history/plot helpers are not an SI orbital interface.
